versions.name: Sports
versions.description: Train for two chosen sports across a season, charting practice and progress, and learn each game's rules, etiquette, gear and playing area alongside the conditioning and diet that keep an athlete healthy.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
